author: trae142
quote:
I dont mind that its mostly boyfriend simulator. I like my dating Sims. But this should have been a different game. At the end of the day, every non fan is screaming about how the story is fine. But almost no one played any GTA for the story. We want to go in, drive reckless, blow things up, see how long we can kill people before we die, and try again. The fact that the game series KNOWN for being a bad person, is now giving you a bad ending for doing bad things, and will even PERMANENTLY make you irredeemable? This jist isnt fun.

Also, at least for me, the controls are slow, not quickly responsive, and irritating to get use to. 

Bugs are a little better than Cyberpunk on release which if we remember, got so much hate that Playstation removed it. But for some reason since its GTA we should ignore this. Okay.
